headlines.description: — Connor McMichael had a goal and an assist, and the Washington Capitals snapped Chicago's four-game win streak with a 5-1 over the depleted Blackhawks on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McMichael and Ovechkin score as the Capitals beat the depleted Blackhawks 5-1

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele scored two goals, Vladislav Namestnikov and Jonathan Toews both ended lengthy goal-scoring droughts, and the Winnipeg Jets ended their 11-game losing streak with a 5-1 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele's two goals help Jets snap 11-game losing streak with 5-1 win over Kings

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Nick Schmaltz scored twice and assisted on another goal to lead the Utah Mammoth to a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Schmaltz scores twice to power Mammoth past the Blues, 4-2
